title: Cultural Misalignment in Large Language Models: Detection, Measurement, and Mitigation Through Targeted Fine-Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with country-specific personas (USA, China, Slovakia) and comparing their simulated survey response distributions against actual human data from the World Values Survey using the normalized Wasserstein distance.
Evaluating the distributional alignment of model responses with human survey data by conditioning prompts on specific age groups (18-29, 30-49, 50-64, 65+) within intersectional personas.
Measuring the Wasserstein distance between model-generated responses and human survey data for personas explicitly prompted with male and female demographic attributes.
Assessing the alignment of model responses against human baseline data for simulated personas conditioned on distinct educational attainment levels (lower, medium, higher).
